item.title: Press release: Bottomline’s Paymode solution named a Market Leader in AP automation and payments
item.description: 26th February 2026 – Bottomline, a global leader in business payments, today announced it has been named a Market Leader in the 2026 AP Automation and Payments Technology Advisor report from Ardent Partners. The post Press release: Bottomline’s Paymode solution named a Market Leader in AP automation and payments first appeared on Treasury Today.

item.title: Press release: Sibos 2026 is coming to Miami
item.description: 26th February 2026 – Registration has opened for Sibos 2026, taking place from 28 September to 1 October at the Miami Beach Convention Centre. The post Press release: Sibos 2026 is coming to Miami first appeared on Treasury Today.

item.title: Press release: Global Corporates bolster FX risk management amidst trade uncertainty
item.description: 1st March 2026 – Global trade turbulence has caused a significant rise in currency volatility, and corporates are combating this by increasing hedging activity. See some key statistics from the research here. The post Press release: Global Corporates bolster FX risk management amidst trade uncertainty first appeared on Treasury Today.

item.title: Press release: Africa Infrastructure Financing Facility launched to strengthen continental financial sovereignty
item.description: 25th February 2026 – African Heads of State and Government on February 14, 2026, formally launched the Africa Infrastructure Financing Facility (AIFF), a coordinated, Africa-led platform designed to accelerate the preparation and facilitation of financing for priority cross-border infrastructure projects aligned with Agenda 2063. The post Press release: Africa Infrastructure Financing Facility launched to strengthen continental financial sovereignty first appeared on Treasury Today.

item.title: Press release: Huawei will release the Agentic Core solution to accelerate the commercial use of agent networks
item.description: 1st March 2026 – Huawei will release the Agentic Core solution at MWC2026 Barcelona. This solution will leverage three engines—NE intelligence, network intelligence, and service intelligence—to address key challenges in the AI era. The post Press release: Huawei will release the Agentic Core solution to accelerate the commercial use of agent networks first appeared on Treasury Today.

item.title: Press release: SAP Taulia delivers SCF transformation for Saudi Electricity Company
item.description: 26th February 2026 – SAP Taulia, a global fintech leader of working capital solutions, today announced the successful launch of a pioneering Supply Chain Finance (SCF) program for the Saudi Electricity Company (SEC). The post Press release: SAP Taulia delivers SCF transformation for Saudi Electricity Company first appeared on Treasury Today.

item.title: Asian treasurers playing catch-up on AI
item.description: Corporates need to be more proactive in bridging the gap between the promise of artificial intelligence and data deficiencies. The post Asian treasurers playing catch-up on AI first appeared on Treasury Today.

item.title: Tariff refund uncertainty clouds treasurers’ planning
item.description: After the US Supreme Court struck down many of Donald Trump’s 2025 tariff orders, American companies are back to the drawing board, rethinking the tariff calculus and how they will be refunded for the unconstitutional levies paid. The court decision, in the middle of earnings season, clouds 2026 guidance. The post Tariff refund uncertainty clouds treasurers’ planning first appeared on Treasury Today.

item.title: Middle Eastern treasury teams lean into resilience; focus on cash visibility
item.description: As instability rocks the Middle East, the region’s corporates are leaning into operational resilience and prioritising liquidity. Elsewhere, companies are preparing for higher energy and shipping costs, plus supply chain disruption. The post Middle Eastern treasury teams lean into resilience; focus on cash visibility first appeared on Treasury Today.

item.title: Mastering markets in motion: why clarity is the new currency
item.description: In volatile global markets, clarity is the new currency. Bloomberg’s Chintan Shah explains why treasurers who integrate authoritative data, analytics and real-time visibility can outperform those relying on fragmented or manual systems. The post Mastering markets in motion: why clarity is the new currency first appeared on Treasury Today.
